sentences.ko: 주말에 진짜 아무것도 안 했는데, 이상하게 그게 딱 필요했던 것 같아. 하루 종일 소파에 누워서 폰만 보다가 하루가 다 갔거든.
sentences.text: I literally did nothing all weekend, but honestly that's exactly what I needed, because I just lay on the couch scrolling on my phone until the day was gone.
alts: I did absolutely nothing this weekend and it turned out to be exactly what I needed, since I basically stayed on the couch on my phone all day.
My whole weekend was doing nothing, which is honestly what I needed, because I spent the entire day lying around on my phone.
sentences.note: literally 는 '진짜, 완전히' 정도로 가볍게 씁니다. scrolling on my phone 은 폰 들여다보는 걸 말할 때 제일 흔한 표현이에요.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 시킨 거랑 완전히 다른 게 왔는데, 다시 시키자니 한 시간은 더 걸릴 것 같고 그냥 이거 먹어야 하나 싶어.
sentences.text: They sent me something completely different from what I ordered, and if I reorder it's going to take another hour, so I'm kind of tempted to just eat this.
alts: What showed up is nothing like what I ordered, but reordering would mean waiting another hour, so I might just eat it anyway.
They got my order completely wrong, and since ordering again means another hour of waiting, I'm honestly thinking about just eating what they sent.
sentences.note: kind of tempted to ~ 는 '그냥 ~할까 싶다' 하는 미묘한 느낌입니다. nothing like ~ 는 '~랑 완전히 다르다'.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 도와주고는 싶은데 이번 주는 진짜 정신이 없어서, 괜히 맡았다가 제대로 못 해 주면 오히려 너한테 더 민폐일 것 같아.
sentences.text: I'd really like to help, but this week is honestly insane for me, and if I take it on and do a bad job, that just makes things worse for you.
alts: I want to help you out, but I'm swamped this week, and I'd rather say no than take it on and end up letting you down.
I would help if I could, but things are crazy right now, and me doing it badly would be worse for you than me just saying no.
sentences.note: 거절은 '하고 싶은데(I'd like to) → 상황(but) → 오히려 너한테 안 좋다' 순서면 부드럽습니다. swamped = 일에 파묻혀 있다.

sentences.ko: 이번엔 진짜 될 줄 알았는데 또 삼일 만에 무너졌어. 저녁까지는 잘 참다가 밤에 배고파지면 도저히 안 되더라고.
sentences.text: I really thought I'd stick with it this time, but I caved after three days, because I can hold out until dinner and then the late night hunger just wins.
alts: I was sure I'd last this time, but I gave up after three days, since I'm fine until dinner and then I get hungry at night.
I thought this time would be different, but three days in I gave in, because holding out until dinner is fine and then night hits.
sentences.note: cave 와 give in 둘 다 '참다가 무너지다'입니다. stick with it = 계속 유지하다, hold out = 버티다.

sentences.ko: 이사를 갈까 싶다가도, 지금 집이 딱히 나쁜 것도 아닌데 괜히 돈이랑 시간만 버리는 거 아닌가 싶어서 계속 미루고 있어.
sentences.text: Part of me wants to move, but the place I'm in now isn't actually bad, so I keep wondering if I'd just be wasting money and time, and I put it off.
alts: I keep thinking about moving, but there's nothing really wrong with my current place, so I wonder if it's just a waste of money and time.
I go back and forth on moving, because my place is fine as it is, and I'm not sure it's worth the money and the hassle.
sentences.note: Part of me wants to ~ 는 '~하고 싶은 마음도 있다'. go back and forth on ~ 은 결정 못 하고 오락가락한다는 뜻이고, put it off 는 미루다입니다.
